# hazard severity

The hazard's graded severity, when graded standalone (a hazard feeding a cascade usually inherits attention from the cascade's grade). NOT functional (PR #385 review — evaluative, source-variable; the hasAuthorityLevel convention); optional, at most one per base graph (SHACL).

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hazardSeverity>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:hazardSeverity`  

**Type:** `owl:ObjectProperty`
